text:
amanda.chang: Hey team — CorpBank HIT the compliance checkpoint this morning. They want a Private VPC path for the POC but also need to validate fallback peering for DR. Can we confirm recommended topology and any hit to pricing?

raj.patel: Quick take — two options: 1) PrivateLink endpoints in customer's VPC pointing to our Private deployment NLBs (recommended for security), 2) VPC peering to a dedicated VPC with NAT/egress control (simpler but more blast-radius).

ben_netops: For option 1 (PrivateLink) network team needs the service name and the endpoint policy. Customer asked whether we support cross-account endpoint acceptance via principal allowlist — yes, but need exact AWS account IDs. Also note PrivateLink avoids public IPs so good for compliance.

sophie_sec: From security: corp requires mutual TLS to the private endpoint and audit logs forwarded to their SIEM. We can expose mTLS on the NLB using customer certs (they want their CA). Also need to confirm KMS integration for model telemetry (they require CMK).

amanda.chang: Pricing note from sales — customer is sensitive to egress charges. How much additional egress if we route model responses through PrivateLink vs our hosted API? any delta?

raj.patel: PrivateLink still goes over AWS internal network, but if our Private deployment sits in a different account/region there can be inter-AZ or inter-region transfer costs. For same-region PrivateLink: minimal data transfer fees vs internet egress. Peering could incur transit through shared NAT if they force egress through their on-prem — depends on topology.

ben_netops: Practical checklist for CorpBank POC: 
- Provide AWS account IDs and prefixes to accept endpoints
- Provide CIDR ranges for peered VPCs if choosing peering
- Firewall rules: allow outbound 443 to our endpoint IPs or accept PrivateLink service name
- If they insist on peered path we need a route table entry example

sophie_sec: Also sending them the security questionnaire section re: network controls. Amanda, can you get their SOC2 appendix and list of approved CAs?

amanda.chang: On it. I'll pull the SOC docs tonight. Timelines — customer wants POC up next Tue. Is that feasible?

raj.patel: Feasible if we get the account IDs and certs by EOD Friday. We'll pre-create the service and share the service name for PrivateLink. For peering approach we need Terraform templates and a peering request flow; that takes longer (engineering handshake).

ben_netops: Sample firewall snippet they can paste into their egress policy: 
```
# Allow to Redwood PrivateLink NLB (same-region)
- proto: tcp
  port: 443
  dest: vpce-svc-0123456789abcdef (or NLB IPs if using peering)
  comment: Allow TLS to Redwood inference endpoints
```
If peering: add route: `0.0.0.0/0 -> vpc-peering-123` only if they want to proxy all traffic, otherwise restrict CIDRs to our subnets.

infra-bot: deploy-checklist: service-create, endpoint-policy-draft, tls-config, kinesis-logship-config. Status: queued.

sophie_sec: Data residency ask — they want logs retained for 7 years on their archive. Need to confirm retention and whether we can push raw logs to their S3 via cross-account role. We can if they provide bucket ARN and IAM role with PutObject.

amanda.chang: For the security questionnaire answer regarding encryption-in-transit, I'll propose: TLS 1.2+ with mutual certs for PrivateLink plus mTLS optional for peering. For encryption-at-rest: CMK control for telemetry and model artifacts. Sophie, ok to finalize?

sophie_sec: Yes, that's acceptable. Add note: we will redact user PII from logs by default; if they need full payloads we require a separate DPA and SOC2 addendum.

raj.patel: Next steps: Amanda collects account IDs, certs, SOC pack. Ben will draft endpoint policy and firewall snippet. I'll stand by to create the PrivateLink service and share the service name. If they prefer peering, we'll send Terraform and a peering runbook.

amanda.chang: Great — I'll loop in the customer and ask for (1) AWS account IDs, (2) CAs and certs, (3) SIEM endpoint/role, (4) confirmation on whether they want PrivateLink or peering. ETA EOD Fri. :thumbsup:

ben_netops: I'll put the firewall snippet and a minimal Terraform example in a gated doc for the customer after Amanda confirms.

amanda.chang: Thanks all — pinging @corpbank-security to kick off their cert transfer.

sophie_sec: :eyes:

infra-bot: reminder: schedule canary for private service after endpoint acceptance.

amanda.chang: Closing note — Pricing: I'll attach an estimate showing expected inter-region vs same-region transfer costs and a simple monthly POC run cost (tokens + minimal infra). Will share in channel once ready.

raj.patel: Sounds good. If timeline slips we can run a temporary hosted-token-proxy as fallback (less secure) to keep the demo on time.

amanda.chang: OK, closing thread — will update with assets.
